title: From the Perfection of Īmān
arabic_text: عن أبي حمزةَ أنسِ بنِ مالكٍ رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُ خادمِ messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عن النَّبيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قالَ: "لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَِخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ".
english_translation: From Abū Ḥamzah Anas bin Mālik (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhu), the servant of the Messenger of Allāh (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam), from the Prophet (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam), that he said, 'None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.'
description: This Hadith emphasizes a fundamental principle of Islamic faith: that a believer does not truly believe until they desire for their brother (in humanity and faith) what they desire for themselves. It is a cornerstone of mutual love, empathy, and brotherhood in Islam.
